title: Mastering Revision Cycle Count
dataSources: Release events (`music:distribution`), Bandcamp activity (`music:bandcamp`), project exports (`music:project`), streaming analytics (`music:streaming`), metadata tasks (`music:ops`).
app: Music-making and creator telemetry — DistroKid release exports, Bandcamp sales activity, Cockos Reaper project stats, and Spotify for Artists analytics — streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs, exports, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=music:project engineer=* revision_cycles=*
| stats avg(revision_cycles) as avg_revision_cycles, count as events by engineer
| sort - avg_revision_cycles
description: Shows average revision cycles by mastering engineer for mastering rounds.
value: Average revision cycles by mastering engineer helps compare mastering rounds across the factors that matter most.
implementation: Capture `revision_cycles` on `music:project` events and normalize `engineer` so Splunk can summarize performance by mastering engineer.
visualization: Bar chart of average revision cycles by mastering engineer.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers the average revision cycles for each mastering engineer so you can see what works best for mastering rounds.
